note: Hand judgement by the vocabulary-quality pass, NOT a native-speaker review. Every row stays proofread:false. overrides: id -> fields applied after the deterministic rules in tools/vocab/refine.py. additions: words absent from the ranked pool, inserted at an approximate priority (see docs/vocab/METHOD.md); pointed forms and no gloss text come from Wiktionary only where marked. extraForms: forms listed under a lemma. The "rank" inside an override is the approximate rank at the time it was written (informational; ids are the key). swapRankWith: id of another entry with the same unpointed spelling; the two exchange rank (and tier) because frequency was counted per spelling, so the common word should hold the higher slot.
fields: gloss, pos, topic, pointed (null = unpointed), fn, tags (replace), addTags, formOf ("lemma|pos"), flags (object, e.g. {"hidden": true})
